name: Sheraton Kauai Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort on Poipu Beach on Kauai's South Shore, with oceanfront and garden-view rooms, an Ocean Pool steps from the sand and an oceanfront luau
best_for: Travelers who want a resort right on Poipu Beach
Couples who want an oceanfront suite with Pacific views
Guests who want snorkeling and stand-up paddleboarding near the resort

facts.text: The resort sits along the shores of Poipu Beach.
Guest rooms and suites have oceanfront or garden views.
Rooms have a private outdoor balcony.
Suites offer more space and views of the Pacific Ocean.
Guests can relax in a shaded cabana or at the Ocean Pool, steps from the sand.
The Aulii Luau is an oceanfront luau on Poipu Beach on the South Shore.
Lava's at the Garden Pool serves island-inspired, fresh and healthy options.
Poolside bungalow rentals offer a secluded getaway.
Guests can try snorkeling or stand-up paddleboarding near Poipu Beach.
Families can explore canals by tubing through a plantation.
The hotel is near Waimea Canyon.
The hotel is Hawaii Green Business Program certified.

highlights.text: The resort sits along the shores of Poipu Beach, with an Ocean Pool steps from the sand and shaded cabanas.
The Aulii Luau is an oceanfront luau on Poipu Beach on the South Shore.
Suites offer more space and views of the Pacific Ocean, and rooms have a private outdoor balcony.
Poolside bungalow rentals offer a secluded getaway.
Guests can try snorkeling or stand-up paddleboarding near Poipu Beach.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Lihue Airport, approximately 14.1 miles from the hotel.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
